captions.detailed: A medieval-style siege cannon featuring a long, dark iron barrel resting on a heavy timber carriage. The carriage is constructed from dark brown wooden beams and is supported by four detailed spoked wheels with iron treads. The barrel can rotate vertically on its trunnions, and all four wheels are capable of spinning on their respective axle joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a siege cannon with a long iron barrel mounted on a four-wheeled wooden carriage. The barrel should have a revolute joint on its trunnions for elevation, and the wheels should have revolute joints on their axles.
captions.factory: The code defines a base carriage body using a combination of box primitives for the wooden frame and side panels. The wheels are constructed by combining a central cylinder hub, multiple small rectangular boxes for the spokes, and an outer ring. The barrel is modeled using concentric cylinders for the main body, muzzle, and breech, capped with a sphere. Revolute joints are configured to link the wheels to the carriage axles and the barrel trunnions to the carriage frame.
